name: HD 238108

text.card: One of the two unrelated stars that Charles Messier catalogued as M40.
text.introduction: M40, also called Winnecke 4, is an optical double: this star lies nearer than its apparent partner, HD 238107.
text.locator: Abstract: Messier 40 comprises a pair of entirely unrelated stars (Hipparcos/Gaia parallaxes)

notes: M40 has no package of its own: it is two unrelated stars, each drawn as its own body.
